title: 买水果

explanations.1: connects the subject 我 and 朋友, meaning 'and'.
explanations.2: indicates the action is done together with the friend.
explanations.3: introduces the starting point (home) for the action 去.
explanations.4: means 'home', the place they leave from.
explanations.5: indicates the location inside the store.
explanations.6: is an adverb meaning 'very', modifying the quantity 多.
explanations.7: means 'first', indicating the sequence of actions.
explanations.8: is the second-person pronoun, used to address the friend.
explanations.9: is a modal verb meaning 'can', asking about ability or willingness.
explanations.10: is a question word meaning 'what', asking about the item to buy.
explanations.11: is a structural particle indicating attribute, here linking 大 and 苹果.
explanations.12: is a common noun for apple, the item being bought.
explanations.13: is a number indicating price per jin.
explanations.14: is a measure word for Chinese currency (yuan).
explanations.15: is a dynamic particle indicating the completion of the action 买.
explanations.16: is a general measure word for countable nouns, used with 三.
explanations.17: is a negative adverb meaning 'did not', negating the action 买.
explanations.18: is a number meaning 'two', used with 斤 to indicate quantity.
explanations.19: is a demonstrative pronoun meaning 'this', referring to the specific apple.
explanations.20: is an adverb meaning 'really', intensifying the adjective 开心.

translation: This morning, my friend and I went to the store together from home. There were many fruits in the store. We looked at the fruits first. My friend asked, 'What can you buy?' I said, 'I buy big apples.' The apples were five yuan per jin, very cheap. I bought three apples. My friend did not buy bananas; he bought two jin of oranges. We spent twenty yuan in total. Then we went home. Mom saw our fruits and was very happy. She ate an apple and said this apple is very delicious. We also happily ate an orange. Today was really happy.
